issue.title: Stable Agent.selection_key for container rows
issue.description:
# Stable Agent.selection_key for container rows

Deferred from the approved plan `202609/agents_panel_focus_follows_selection.md`
(Out of scope, item 2), tracing research report
`research:202609/agents_tab_panel_focus_snap/agents_tab_panel_focus_snap.md`
§5.3 / §7.5(b): `Agent.identity` is unstable for container rows.

## What is wrong

Container rows (clan / family containers) do not have a stable identity across
refreshes: `Agent.identity` for a container is derived from mutable membership
rather than a persistent key, so the identity-restore path in
`finalize_agent_list` / `_select_finalize_plan` can miss even when the same
logical container is still rendered. Fixing this needs a model-level identity
change (a stable `Agent.selection_key` for container rows), which carries
medium risk and is deliberately out of scope for the focus-follows-selection
plan.

## Status after Steps 1-3

After the focus-follows-selection fix lands, the failure is survivable: a
missed container identity falls back to the `prior_pos` neighbor restore in
the same panel instead of a global-index clamp. This bead tracks the
model-level fix that would make the fallback unnecessary.

## Repro

1. Read `research:202609/agents_tab_panel_focus_snap/agents_tab_panel_focus_snap.md`
   §5.3 / §7.5(b).
2. Observe a container row (clan or imported/remote family container) across
   two refreshes where membership changed: `Agent.identity`
   (`src/sase/ace/tui/models/agent.py`) yields a different tuple, so
   selection restoration by identity misses.

## Impact

Agents-tab cursor restoration for container rows; mitigated by the same-panel
neighbor fallback until the model-level key exists.
